Title: Public preview: Azure Maps Creator – Improved indoor maps onboarding and new Features API

Body.Content:
Creation of indoor maps with Creator is now easier than ever!

The updated Conversion service now allows you to easily convert your DWG floorplans to indoor maps with little to no modifications. You can now bring any additional data from your AutoCAD files into your indoor maps such as funiture, POIs or plumbing schematics.

A new Features API, that is OGC compliant, is in Public Preview. This allows you to easily query and visualize your map data in any GIS tooling that supports a Features layer. We have also introduced Features write APIs that allow you to add or edit any map feature in Creator.

To get started with the new onboarding, see how-to Create a drawing package and drawing package requirements.

To get started with the Features API, see Features API.

To get started with Azure Maps and Azure Maps Creator, see Azure Maps and Azure Maps Creator.
